title: Supreme Court proposes ladies' Bar rooms across courts, financial support for young lawyers
description: The Supreme Court has taken note of the absence of adequately equipped ladies' Bar rooms across courts in the country and proposed setting up a fund to financially support young advocates during their early years of practice.A Bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justice V Mohana was hearing a plea filed by a group of women advocates practising across courts in the country, raising concerns about the accessibility, inclusiveness and long-term sustainability of women lawyers in the legal profession.CJI Su
